<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are: 143.10, 139.03, 135.88, 129.50 (2), 129.01 (2), 128.90 (2), 128.50 (2), and 127.20 ppm. Counting each carbon represented by these signals (including the duplicated peaks that correspond to equivalent carbons) gives 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
